Once you go for an exchange, they increase the product price by ₹100.

If anyone else faces the same issue, raise your voice and insist on exchange at the original price you already paid.

If you want to experience this go in morning by 11am ask the clothes price of three -four product record the voice or video recording and go for exchange at night and tell them goio want to exchange and ask the price of the same clothes which you asked in morning the rate of the same clothes will be increased by them by 50₹-to 100₹ record the thing and then give them lesson.

featured_reviews.name: Ali Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased clothing from Poshak for men and am thoroughly impressed with their service and product quality. The customer service was outstanding; the staff were attentive, friendly, and went out of their way to ensure a smooth shopping experience.

The cloth material is top-notch, with a luxurious feel and durability that speaks of high quality. The stitching is impeccable, showcasing the brand's commitment to detail and craftsmanship.

Moreover, the fitting was amazing – it's rare to find such precision in off-the-rack clothing. Poshak has truly set a high standard in men's fashion, and I highly recommend them for anyone seeking stylish, well-made garments and exceptional customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Parin Gohil
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been a loyal customer of Poshak for men for many years, and they never disappoint. Their customer service is consistently excellent, and the quality of cloth, stitching, and fit is unparalleled. Poshak truly stands out in men’s fashion, and I highly recommend them for any occasion.
